label: Bible Study
prompt: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the _____ shall be the LORD'S.
verse: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.
note: The last line of the Old Testament's shortest book — the kingdom belongs to the LORD.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in _____ by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verse: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
note: Moses blesses Benjamin, 'the beloved of the LORD': safe all day long, resting between God's shoulders.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and _____.
verse: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
note: Every three years Solomon's ships came home with gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks — a royal zoo shipment.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore being _____ by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verse: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
note: After four chapters of courtroom argument, Paul announces the verdict — and its first fruit is peace with God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, _____ you like men, be strong.
verse: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
note: 'Quit you like men' is old English for 'conduct yourselves' — act like grown-ups. It doesn't mean give up!
